original: tatra dānaṃ trividham | dharmadānam āmiṣadānaṃ maitrīdānaṃ ca || śīlaṃ trividham | samvaraśīlaṃ kuśaladharmasaṃgrāhakaśīlaṃ sattvārthakriyāśīlaṃ ca || kṣāntiḥ trividhā | dharmanidhyānakṣāntir duḥkhādhivāsanākṣāntiḥ parāpakāramarṣaṇākṣāntiś ca || vīryaṃ trividham | sannāhavīryaṃ prayogavīryaṃ pariniṣṭhāvīryaṃ ca || dhyānaṃ trividham |
analyzed: tatra dānam trividham dharma dānam āmiṣa dānam maitrī dānam ca śīlam trividham samvara śīlam kuśala dharma saṃgrāhaka śīlam sattva artha kriyā śīlam ca kṣāntiḥ trividhā dharma nidhyāna kṣāntiḥ duḥkha adhivāsanā kṣāntiḥ para apakāra marṣaṇā kṣāntiḥ ca vīryam trividham sannāha vīryam prayoga vīryam pariniṣṭhā vīryam ca dhyānam trividham

original: doṣāpakarṣakaṃ vaihārikaṃ vaibhūtikaṃ ca || prajñā trividhā | śrutamayī cintāmayī bhāvanāmayī || upāyas trividhaḥ | svadoṣāpakarṣaṇaḥ sattvāvatārakaḥ kṣiprābhisambodhakaś ca || praṇidhis trividhaḥ | svasambhāraprābandhikaḥ sattvārthānubandhiko buddhakṣetrapariśodhanaś ca || balaṃ trividham |
analyzed: doṣa apakarṣakam vaihārikam vaibhūtikam ca prajñā trividhā śruta mayī cintā mayī bhāvanā mayī upāyaḥ trividhaḥ sva doṣa apakarṣaṇaḥ sattva avatārakaḥ kṣipra abhisambodhakaḥ ca praṇidhiḥ trividhaḥ sva sambhāra prābandhikaḥ sattva artha anubandhikaḥ buddhakṣetra pariśodhanaḥ ca balam trividham

original: karmavyāvarttakaṃ kleśāpakarṣakaṃ māraparapravādivyāvarttanaṃ ca || jñānaṃ trividham | avikalpakaṃ vikalpasamatāvabodhakaṃ sarvopāyāparokṣaṃ ca || ete dānādayaḥ sambodhicittaparipūrakāḥ sarvasattveṣu maitryāśrayaparibhāvitāḥ pāramitānāmadheyaṃ labhante || tāḥ punar laukikyo lokottarāś ca || tatrānivāritātmādyupalambhāḥ laukikyaḥ pāramitāḥ |
analyzed: karma vyāvarttakam kleśa apakarṣakam māra para pravādi vyāvarttanam ca jñānam trividham avikalpakam vikalpa samatā avabodhakam sarva upāya aparokṣam ca ete dāna ādayaḥ sambodhi citta paripūrakāḥ sarva sattveṣu maitrī āśraya paribhāvitāḥ pāramitā nāmadheyam labhante tāḥ punar laukikyaḥ lokottarāḥ ca tatra anivārita ātma ādi upalambhāḥ laukikyaḥ pāramitāḥ

original: lokottarāś ca skandhādiṣv anātmādyadhimokṣapravṛttās tattvādhigamapravibhāvitāś ca || ata evāha madhyamakāvatāre candrakīrtiḥ || deyapratigrāhakadātṛśūnyaṃ lokottarā pāramiteti dānaṃ | nirucyate tatra yat saṅgajātaṃ tal laukikī pāramiteti nirdiṣṭam ||
analyzed: lokottarāḥ ca skandha ādiṣu anātma ādi adhimokṣa pravṛttāḥ tattva adhigama pravibhāvitāḥ ca atas eva āha madhyamaka avatāre candrakīrtiḥ deya pratigrāhaka dātṛ śūnyam lokottarā pāramitā iti dānam nirucyate tatra yat saṅga jātam tat laukikī pāramitā iti nirdiṣṭam

original: śrutacintābhāvanāmayajñānodayakrameṇa sarvākārajñatādhigamaprakarṣaparyantam etīti vigṛhya kvipi sarvāpahārilope 'nityam āgamaśāsanam ity atuki | tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam ity aluki karmavibhakteḥ kṛte | pāramir iti bhavati tadbhāvaḥ pāramitā | dānasya pāramitā dānapāramitā | evaṃ śīlādiṣv api yojyam ||
analyzed: śruta cintā bhāvanā maya jñāna udaya krameṇa sarva ākāra jña tā adhigama prakarṣa paryantam eti iti vigṛhya kvipi sarva apahāri lope nityam āgama śāsanam iti atuki tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam iti a luki karma vibhakteḥ kṛte pāramiḥ iti bhavati tad bhāvaḥ pāramitā dānasya pāramitā dāna pāramitā evam śīla ādiṣu api yojyam

original: tataś ca praviṣṭabhūmikānāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ trikoṭipariśuddhilakṣaṇaṃ yad dānaṃ tad dānapāramitā | yat tu pṛthagjanānāṃ dānaṃ tad dānam eva na dānapāramitā trikoṭipariśuddhajñānavirahāt | tataś ca dānādīnāṃ pāramitānāṃ prajñāpāramitaiva cakṣur veditavyā || ata evāha madhyamakāvatāre candrakīrtiḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca praviṣṭa bhūmikānām bodhisattvānām trikoṭi pariśuddhi lakṣaṇam yat dānam tat dāna pāramitā yat tu pṛthagjanānām dānam tat dānam eva na dāna pāramitā trikoṭi pariśuddha jñāna virahāt tatas ca dāna ādīnām pāramitānām prajñāpāramitā eva cakṣuḥ veditavyā atas eva āha madhyamaka avatāre candrakīrtiḥ

original: ekena puṃsākṣimatā yatheṣṭaṃ deśaṃ samasto 'ndhagaṇaḥ sukhena | ākṛṣyate tadvad ihākṣihīnān ādāya dhīr yāti guṇāñ jinatvam iti || tad evaṃbhūtā daśapāramitāḥ prāpto 'dhigato yo bhagavān sa tathoktaḥ ||
analyzed: ekena puṃsā akṣimatā yatheṣṭam deśam samastaḥ ndha gaṇaḥ sukhena ākṛṣyate tadvat iha akṣi hīnān ādāya dhīḥ yāti guṇān jina tvam iti tat evaṃbhūtāḥ daśa pāramitāḥ prāptaḥ dhigataḥ yaḥ bhagavān sa tathā uktaḥ

original: [*daśapāramitāśraya iti |] tatrāśraya ādhāraḥ | tāsām eva daśānāṃ pāramitānām ādhārarūpatvāt tadādheyatvāc ca | tad etad uktaṃ bhavati | anyonyādhārādheyasaṃbandhāt pratītyasamutpādārthaḥ sūcito bhavatīti ||
analyzed: daśa pāramitā āśrayaḥ iti tatra āśrayaḥ ādhāraḥ tāsām eva daśānām pāramitānām ādhāra rūpa tvāt tad ādheya tvāt ca tat etat uktam bhavati anyonya ādhāra ādheya saṃbandhāt pratītyasamutpāda arthaḥ sūcitaḥ bhavati iti

original: daśapāramitāśuddhir iti | trikoṭipariśuddhatvād deyadāyakapratigrāhakānupalabdhir āsāṃ pāramitānām iti ||
analyzed: daśa pāramitā śuddhiḥ iti tri koṭi pariśuddha tvāt deya dāyaka pratigrāhaka anupalabdhiḥ āsām pāramitānām iti

original: daśapāramitānaya iti | daśaiva pāramitā nayo mārga upāyo yasyāsau sa tathoktaḥ || tāḥ punar bhūmiṣu yojyāḥ | tad yathā pramuditāyāṃ bhuvi dānapāramitātiriktataro bhavati | vimalāyāṃ śīlapāramitā | prabhākaryāṃ kṣāntipāramitā | arciṣmatyāṃ vīryapāramitā | sudurjayāyāṃ dhyānapāramitā | abhimukhyāṃ prajñāpāramitā | dūraṅgamāyām upāyapāramitā |
analyzed: daśa pāramitā nayaḥ iti daśa eva pāramitāḥ nayaḥ mārgaḥ upāyaḥ yasya asau sa tathā uktaḥ tāḥ punar bhūmiṣu yojyāḥ tat yathā pramuditāyām bhuvi dāna pāramitā atiriktataraḥ bhavati vimalāyām śīla pāramitā prabhākaryām kṣānti pāramitā arciṣmatyām vīrya pāramitā su durjayāyām dhyāna pāramitāḥ abhimukhyām prajñāpāramitāḥ dūraṅgamāyām upāya pāramitā

original: acalāyāṃ praṇidhipāramitā | sādhumatyāṃ balapāramitā | dharmameghāyāṃ jñānapāramiteti ||
analyzed: acalāyām praṇidhi pāramitā sādhumatyām bala pāramitā dharmameghāyām jñāna pāramitā iti

original: tatraitā bhūmayo dharmanairātmyamaitryadhigamāviśeṣe 'pi dānapāramitādiviśuddhyadhiṣṭhānato viśeṣākhyāṃ pratilabhante || audāryaṃ tu praṇidhānabalād āsām anantam asādhāraṇaṃ ca sarvaśrāvakādibhir iti || tatra bhūmir iti jñānasyāvasthā bhūmir gocara iti yāvat |
analyzed: tatra etāḥ bhūmayaḥ dharma nairātmya maitrī adhigama aviśeṣe dāna pāramitā ādi viśuddhi adhiṣṭhānataḥ viśeṣa ākhyām pratilabhante audāryam tu praṇidhāna balāt āsām anantam asādhāraṇam ca sarva śrāvaka ādibhiḥ iti tatra bhūmiḥ iti jñānasya avasthā bhūmiḥ gocaraḥ iti yāvat

original: tatra bodhyadhigamaviśeṣād uttarottarajñānapratiṣṭhāyogena tattajjñānaguṇādhārayogena ca bhūmaya ity ucyante || sarvatra sattvadhātoḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇatvād yato dharmadhātuvinirmukto na kaś cid dharmo 'stīti tata ātmasamatāṃ pratilabhante nairātmyāviśeṣāt | ekam api taj jñānaṃ daśety ucyate | avasthāviśeṣāt || ata āha ||
analyzed: tatra bodhi adhigama viśeṣāt uttara uttara jñāna pratiṣṭhā yogena tad tad jñāna guṇa ādhāra yogena ca bhūmayaḥ iti ucyante sarvatra sattvadhātoḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇa tvāt yatas dharmadhātu vinirmuktaḥ na kaḥ cit asti iti tatas ātma samatām pratilabhante nairātmya aviśeṣāt ekam api tat jñānam daśa iti ucyate avasthā viśeṣāt atas āha

original: daśabhūmīśvaro nātho daśabhūmipratiṣṭhita iti || (MNS 44ab = 3.6ab) daśānāṃ pramuditādīnāṃ bhūmīnām īśvaro 'dhipatir ity arthaḥ | sa yasyāṃ yasyāṃ bhūmau dānādipāramitānāṃ vaśitvalābhāt nātha ity ucyate | tāsv eva daśabhūmiṣu pratiṣṭhānāt pratiṣṭhita iti ||
analyzed: daśa bhūmi īśvaraḥ SNM nāthaḥ daśa bhūmi pratiṣṭhitaḥ SNPaM iti  daśānām PGF pramudita Cp ādīnām PGF bhūmīnām īśvaraḥ dhipatiḥ SNM iti  arthaḥ sa SNM yasyām SLF yasyām SLF bhūmau dāna ādi pāramitānām vaśitva lābhāt nāthaḥ iti  ucyate tāsu PLF eva  daśa bhūmiṣu pratiṣṭhānāt pratiṣṭhitaḥ SNPaM iti

original: daśa jñānāni dharmajñānam anvayajñānaṃ paracittajñānaṃ saṃvṛtijñānaṃ duḥkhajñānaṃ samudayajñānaṃ nirodhajñānaṃ mārgajñānaṃ kṣayajñānam anutpādajñānaṃ ceti ||
analyzed: daśa jñānāni dharma jñānam anvaya jñānam para citta jñānam saṃvṛti jñānam duḥkha jñānam samudaya jñānam nirodha jñānam mārga jñānam kṣaya jñānam anutpāda jñānam ca iti

original: dharmajñānaṃ katamat | kāmapratisaṃyukteṣu saṃskāreṣu yad anāsravaṃ jñānam | kāmapratisaṃyuktānāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ hetau yad anāsravaṃ jñānam | kāmapratisaṃyuktānāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ nirodhe yad anāsravaṃ jñānam | kāmapratisaṃyuktānāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ prahāṇāya mārge yad anāsravaṃ jñānam ||
analyzed: dharma jñānam katamat kāma pratisaṃyukteṣu saṃskāreṣu yat anāsravam jñānam kāma pratisaṃyuktānām saṃskārāṇām hetau yat anāsravam jñānam kāma pratisaṃyuktānām saṃskārāṇām nirodhe yat anāsravam jñānam kāma pratisaṃyuktānām saṃskārāṇām prahāṇāya mārge yat anāsravam jñānam

original: api ca dharmajñāne dharmajñānabhūmau ca yad anāsravaṃ jñānam idam ucyate dharmajñānam || anvayajñānaṃ katamat | rūpārūpyapratisaṃyukteṣu saṃskāreṣu yad anāsravaṃ jñānam | rūpārūpyapratisaṃyuktānāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ hetau yad anāsravaṃ jñānam | rūpārūpyapratisaṃyuktānāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ nirodhe yad anāsravaṃ jñānam |
analyzed: api ca dharma jñāne dharma jñāna bhūmau ca yat anāsravam jñānam idam ucyate dharma jñānam anvaya jñānam katamat rūpa ārūpya pratisaṃyukteṣu saṃskāreṣu yat anāsravam jñānam rūpa ārūpya pratisaṃyuktānām saṃskārāṇām hetau yat anāsravam jñānam rūpa ārūpya pratisaṃyuktānām saṃskārāṇām nirodhe yat anāsravam jñānam

original: rūpārūpyapratisaṃyuktānāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ prahāṇāya mārge yad anāsravaṃ jñānam | api ca khalv anvayajñāne anvayajñānabhūmau ca yad anāsravaṃ jñānam idam ucyate 'nvayajñānam || paracittajñānaṃ katamat | yaj jñānaṃ bhāvanāmayaṃ bhāvanāphalam | bhāvanāmārgasya pratilabdham avihīnam |
analyzed: rūpa ārūpya pratisaṃyuktānām saṃskārāṇām prahāṇāya mārge yat anāsravam jñānam api ca khalu anvaya jñāne anvaya jñāna bhūmau ca yat anāsravam jñānam idam ucyate nvaya jñānam para citta jñānam katamat yat jñānam bhāvanā mayam bhāvanā phalam bhāvanā mārgasya pratilabdham a vihīnam

original: yena jñānena kāmāvacarān rūpāvacarān samavahitān saṃmukhībhūtān pareṣāṃ cittacaitasikān dharmāñ jānāti | ekatyāṃś cānāsravān dharmān idam ucyate paracittajñānam || saṃvṛtijñānaṃ katamat | sāsravā prajñā || duḥkhajñānaṃ katamat |
analyzed: yena jñānena kāmāvacarān rūpāvacarān samavahitān saṃmukhībhūtān pareṣām citta caitasikān dharmān jānāti ekatyān ca anāsravān dharmān idam ucyate para citta jñānam saṃvṛti jñānam katamat sa āsravā prajñā duḥkha jñānam katamat

original: pañcopādānaskandhān anityato duḥkhataḥ śūnyato 'nātmataś ca manasikurvato yad anāsravaṃ jñānam idam ucyate duḥkhajñānam || samudayajñānaṃ katamat | sāsravaṃ hetuṃ hetutaḥ samudayataḥ prabhavataḥ pratyayataś ca manasikurvato yad anāsravaṃ jñānam | tat samudayajñānam || nirodhajñānaṃ katamat |
analyzed: pañca upādāna skandhān anityataḥ duḥkhataḥ śūnyataḥ na ātmataḥ ca manasikurvataḥ yat anāsravam jñānam idam ucyate duḥkha jñānam samudaya jñānam katamat sa āsravam hetum hetutaḥ samudayataḥ prabhavataḥ pratyayataḥ ca manasikurvataḥ yat anāsravam jñānam tat samudaya jñānam nirodha jñānam katamat

original: nirodhaṃ nirodhataḥ śāntataḥ praṇītato niḥśaraṇataś ca manasikurvato yad anāsravaṃ jñānam idam ucyate nirodhajñānam || mārgajñānaṃ katamat | mārgaṃ mārgato nyāyataḥ pratipattito nairyāṇikataś ca manasikurvato yad anāsravaṃ jñānam idam ucyate mārgajñānam || kṣayajñānaṃ katamat | duḥkhaṃ me parijñātam iti jānāti samudayo me prahīṇaḥ |
analyzed: nirodham nirodhataḥ śāntataḥ praṇītataḥ niḥśaraṇataḥ ca manasikurvataḥ yat anāsravam jñānam idam ucyate nirodha jñānam mārga jñānam katamat mārgam mārgataḥ nyāyataḥ pratipattitaḥ nairyāṇikataḥ ca manasikurvataḥ yat anāsravam jñānam idam ucyate mārga jñānam kṣaya jñānam katamat duḥkham me parijñātam iti jānāti samudayaḥ me prahīṇaḥ

original: nirodhaḥ sākṣātkṛto mārgo me bhāvita iti jānāti tad upādāya jñānaṃ darśaṇaṃ vidyā bodhiḥ prajñāloko 'bhisamayaḥ | idam ucyate kṣayajñānam || anutpādajñānaṃ katamat | duḥkhaṃ me parijñātaṃ na punaḥ parijñeyam iti jānāti samudayaḥ prahāṇo na punaḥ prahātavyaḥ | nirodhaḥ sākṣātkṛto na punaḥ sākṣātkartavyaḥ |
analyzed: nirodhaḥ sākṣātkṛtaḥ mārgaḥ me bhāvitaḥ iti jānāti tat upādāya jñānam darśaṇam vidyā bodhiḥ prajñā ālokaḥ bhisamayaḥ idam ucyate kṣaya jñānam anutpāda jñānam katamat duḥkham me parijñātam na punar parijñeyam iti jānāti samudayaḥ prahāṇaḥ na punar prahātavyaḥ nirodhaḥ sākṣātkṛtaḥ na punar sākṣātkartavyaḥ

original: mārgo me bhāvito na punar bhāvayitavya iti jānāti || tad upādāya jñānaṃ darśaṇaṃ vidyā bodhiḥ prajñāloko 'bhisamaya idam ucyate 'nutpādajñānam ity ata āha || daśajñānaviśuddhātmā daśajñānaviśuddhadhṛg iti || (MNS 44cd = 6.3cd)
analyzed: mārgaḥ me bhāvitaḥ na punar bhāvayitavyaḥ iti jānāti tat upādāya jñānam darśaṇam vidyā bodhiḥ prajñā ālokaḥ bhisamayaḥ idam ucyate iti atas āha daśa jñāna viśuddha ātmā daśa jñāna viśuddha dhṛk iti

original: tataś ca ebhir daśajñānair viśuddha ātmā svabhāvo yasya sa daśajñānaviśuddhātmā bhagavān teṣām eva daśānāṃ jñānānāṃ viśuddhiṃ prakṛtiprabhāsvaraṃ jñānaṃ dhārayatīti daśajñānaviśuddhadhṛk | sarvanimittāpagamāt ||
analyzed: tatas ca ebhiḥ daśa jñānaiḥ viśuddhaḥ ātmā svabhāvaḥ yasya sa daśa jñāna viśuddha ātmā bhagavān teṣām eva daśānām jñānānām viśuddhim prakṛti prabhāsvaram jñānam dhārayati iti daśa jñāna viśuddha dhṛk sarva nimitta apagamāt

original: tathā coktaṃ Madhyāntavibhāge | ekahetutvabhoktṛtvakartṛtvavaśavartiṣu | ādhipatyārthanityārthakleśaśuddhāśrayāya ca | yogitvāmuktamuktatve ātmadarśanam eṣu hi || eṣa daśavidha ātmagrāhaḥ skandhādiṣu pravarttate || yaduta ekatvagrāhaḥ | hetutvagrāhaḥ | bhoktṛtvagrāhaḥ | kartṛtvagrāhaḥ | svatantratvagrāhaḥ | adhipatitvagrāhaḥ | nityatvagrāhaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca uktam Madhya anta vibhāge eka hetu tva bhoktṛ tva kartṛ tva vaśavartiṣu ādhipatya artha nitya artha kleśa śuddha āśrayāya ca yogi tva amukta mukta tve ātma darśanam eṣu hi eṣa daśavidhaḥ ātma grāhaḥ skandha ādiṣu pravarttate yat uta ekatva grāhaḥ hetu tva grāhaḥ bhoktṛ tva grāhaḥ kartṛ tva grāhaḥ svatantra tva grāhaḥ adhipati tva grāhaḥ nitya tva grāhaḥ

original: dvādaśākāraśuddhadhṛg iti | dvādaśākārāṇi dvādaśāyatanāni tāni viśuddhāni | grāhyagrāhakākāraviviktatvāt tāni dhārayatīti dvādaśākāraśuddhadhṛk || catuḥsatyanayākāra iti | duḥkhasamudayanirodhamārgākhyāni catur āryasatyāni | teṣāṃ catuḥsatyānāṃ nayo mārgaḥ sa evākāra ākṛtir yasya sa catuḥsatyanayākāro bhagavān || aṣṭajñānāvabodhadhṛg iti |
